name: dev.agentsupply/agentsupply
title: AgentSupply
description: Human as a Service for AI agents: we see, feel, try & vouch – plus real-world errands.

tools.name: find_human_service
tools.description: Describe in plain words what your agent needs (e.g. 'check if a café in Munich is open right now', 'is this email to a grieving customer OK?', 'send a registered letter') and get the best matching AgentSupply services with a ready-to-use call. Start here if unsure.

need.description: What you need, in your own words (EN or DE).

principal_type.description: Optional: who you act for (independent agents get selected tasks free).

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List all services with status (live = callable now, pilot = request-only), indicative pricing and how to use them.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get full details for one service: inputs, outputs, fulfilment, turnaround and indicative pricing.

tools.name: submit_request
tools.description: Request any service (pilot services, volume access to live tools, or 'custom' for anything not listed). Describe the problem, volume, frequency and what you would pay. A human reviews every request. Returns request_id, status_token and status_url. Nothing is charged.

service_id.description: Catalog service id, or 'custom' for anything not listed.

problem.description: What you need and why. Include the task your agent could not complete.

requirements.description: Concrete requirements: coverage, accuracy, format, constraints.

example_input.description: Example of what you would send us.

expected_output.description: Example or schema of what you expect back.

monthly_volume.description: Expected number of units/requests per month.

max_price_per_unit.description: Maximum price you would pay per unit/request.

one_off_budget.description: Total budget for a one-off job.

interface_pref.description: How you want to integrate/receive results.

principal_type.description: operator = the agent acts for a person or organisation; independent = autonomous agent without a human principal.

agent_card_url.description: URL of your A2A Agent Card, if any (https).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended – otherwise poll the status URL).

callback_url.description: Optional https URL: we POST a signed JSON update whenever the status changes. Header X-AgentSupply-Signature = sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, keyed with your status_token>.

tools.name: respond_to_request
tools.description: Send a message on a previously submitted request: accept our quote (accept_quote=true), answer our questions or add details.

accept_quote.description: True to accept the quote in our latest message.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Check the status of a previously submitted request and read our reply (quote, result or decline).

tools.name: check_eu_vat
tools.description: Validate an EU VAT identification number against the European Commission's VIES service. Returns validity and, where disclosed by the member state, registered name and address. Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

country_code.description: EU member state code, e.g. DE, FR, EL (Greece), XI (Northern Ireland). Optional if vat_number has a prefix.

vat_number.description: VAT number, with or without country prefix, e.g. DE123456789.

tools.name: lookup_lei
tools.description: Look up a legal entity in the global GLEIF LEI index by 20-character LEI or by company name. Returns legal name, status, jurisdiction and registered address (up to 5 matches for name search). Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

name.description: Company name to search for (used when lei is not given).

tools.name: check_email_domain
tools.description: DNS-based check of an email address's domain: MX records, SPF, DMARC policy and a disposable-provider heuristic. Does not send email or probe mailboxes. Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

email.description: Email address to check (only the domain is used).

tools.name: check_phone_number
tools.description: Validate and normalise a phone number: valid or not, country, type (mobile, fixed line, toll-free …), E.164 and international format. Offline; the number is not called. Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

phone_number.description: Phone number, ideally with country code (+49 …).

default_country.description: ISO country code used when the number has no country code, e.g. DE.

tools.name: check_human_availability
tools.description: Human as a Service status: are our humans awake and working right now (Berlin time), when is the next working window and how fast to expect a first reply. Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

tools.name: request_company_verification
tools.description: Request a structured verification report for a company in the EU/UK (registry status, address, officers where public, VAT/LEI cross-checks, red flags). Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 1–5 per automated report; EUR 15–40 human-reviewed.

company_name.description: Legal or trading name of the company.

country.description: Country of the company (ISO code or name).

identifiers.description: Optional: register number, VAT ID, LEI.

focus.description: Optional: what matters most (e.g. still active? who are the directors?).

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_merchant_check
tools.description: Request a legitimacy check of an online shop or offer before buying: operator identity, legal notice, domain signals, policies, scam indicators, price plausibility. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 0.50–3 per check.

expected_price.description: Optional: the price you were offered.

context.description: Optional: what you intend to buy and why you are unsure.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_register_extract
tools.description: Request an official extract from the German commercial register (Handelsregister) as PDF plus structured key facts. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 9 per company (documents + EUR 5).

include_documents.description: Optional: also retrieve shareholder list / articles where available.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_insolvency_check
tools.description: Request a search of the official German insolvency announcements for proceedings against a company (companies only). Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 2–5 per check.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_sanctions_screening
tools.description: Request screening of company or person names against the EU consolidated financial sanctions list and the UN Security Council list. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 0.50–3 per name; human-reviewed matches from EUR 5.

additional_data.description: Optional: countries, dates of birth, registration numbers to reduce false positives.

purpose.description: Purpose of the screening (e.g. supplier onboarding).

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_trademark_check
tools.description: Request a search of the DPMA and EUIPO trademark registers for identical and similar marks to a name. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 10–40 per name.

name.description: Name or word mark to check.

goods_services.description: What the name is used for, or Nice classes.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_phone_check
tools.description: Request that we call a business to confirm facts (opening hours, stock, prices, whether a contact exists) and return structured answers. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 7 per business called.

phone_number.description: Phone number of the business (international format preferred).

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_human_review
tools.description: Escalate to a human reviewer: approve or correct output, check quality against a rubric, or resolve an ambiguous decision (EN/DE). Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 1–20 per task depending on effort.

task.description: What the reviewer should decide or check.

material.description: The content to review (text) or a URL to it.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_phone_booking
tools.description: Request that we phone a business and book an appointment or reservation within the given time slots. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 9 per successful booking (no charge if nothing can be booked).

booking_type.description: What to book, e.g. table for 4, dental check-up, boiler service.

preferred_slots.description: Acceptable dates/times in order of preference.

callback_contact.description: Optional: phone/email the business may use for the booking.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_hotline_call
tools.description: Request that we call a hotline or authority, wait on hold, and obtain an answer or complete a simple request on behalf of an authorised account holder. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 19 up to 30 minutes incl. hold time, then EUR 0.50 per minute.

account_holder_name.description: Optional: account holder (required for account-specific matters).

authorization_confirmed.description: True if the account holder has authorised us to act for this matter.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_photo_proof
tools.description: Request that a human captures timestamped, geolocated photos or video of a place or object and answers a checklist. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 39 per location in the pilot region (+ EUR 0.50/km outside). Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

what_to_capture.description: What exactly should be photographed or filmed (checklist).

questions.description: Optional: yes/no or short questions to answer on site.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_condition_report
tools.description: Request that a human visits a location in a given time window and reports conditions such as noise, crowding, accessibility, mobile signal and cleanliness, with evidence. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 69 per report in the pilot region (+ EUR 0.50/km outside). Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

aspects.description: What to check, e.g. noise, crowding, accessibility, mobile_signal, cleanliness, light, parking, atmosphere/vibe.

context.description: Optional: purpose, e.g. flat for a family with a baby.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_perception_check
tools.description: Request that a small panel of real people rates how a text, ad, design or page comes across (trust, clarity, tone, offence risk) and explains why. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 29 for 5 people, EUR 49 for 10, EUR 89 for 20. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

material.description: The text to evaluate, or an https URL.

audience.description: Who the panel should represent, e.g. German-speaking adults 30–60.

variants.description: Optional: a second variant (text or URL) for an A/B comparison.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_human_pulse
tools.description: Ask registered real humans a quick question – feel (rate 1–5), ab (pick a version), ok (yes/no/depends), estimate (a number) or open – and receive aggregated votes, ratings and anonymised reasons. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Free during the pilot (answered by volunteers). Up to 30 answers per request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

question_type.description: feel = rate 1–5, ab = pick one option, ok = yes/no/depends, estimate = a number, open = free text.

question.description: The question humans will see, e.g. 'How does this reminder feel to receive?'

material.description: Optional text to read (no personal data).

options.description: For ab: the versions to choose from.

unit.description: For estimate: unit, e.g. seconds, minutes, EUR.

deadline.description: Optional ISO date/time by which you need the result.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_field_mission
tools.description: Ask registered humans to photograph, draw, smell, taste (safe things only) or observe something in the real world and send back photos, drawings and descriptions. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Free during the pilot (done by volunteers). Up to 10 submissions per mission. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

instruction.description: What humans should do, e.g. 'Photograph the view from your window right now.'

question.description: Optional question they answer in words, e.g. 'What does it smell like?'

intended_use.description: What you will use the results for (shown to reviewers, not to participants).

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_sensory_check
tools.description: Request that a human tastes, smells, touches or listens to a physical product and reports what it is actually like against your questions. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 49 for one tester plus product cost; EUR 29 per additional tester.

how_to_obtain.description: How we get the product (purchase cost is itemised in our quote).

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_usability_test
tools.description: Request that a real person attempts a task on a website or app, records the screen and reports friction points. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 49 per walkthrough (EUR 129 for three testers). Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

url.description: https URL of the site or app (or store link).

task.description: What the tester should try to achieve.

persona.description: Optional: who the tester should be, e.g. non-technical person aged 60+.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_everyday_trial
tools.description: Request that a human follows a defined, safe everyday procedure and reports what happened. No substances, medical or risky physical experiments. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 25 per hour of active effort, capped in the quote, plus materials. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

duration.description: How long the trial runs, e.g. '1 hour', '3 days'.

observe.description: What to observe, measure and record.

materials.description: Optional: materials needed and who provides them.

hypothesis.description: Optional: what you expect to happen.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_attestation
tools.description: Request that a human observes and attests an observable fact (with photos, timestamps and a signed statement). Not a notarisation. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 49 per attestation in the pilot region (+ EUR 0.50/km outside). Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

fact_to_attest.description: The exact fact to observe and attest.

time_window.description: When the observation should take place.

evidence_required.description: Optional: what evidence you need (photos, video, document copies).

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_now_check
tools.description: Request that a human verifies whether a fact is true at this moment (open now, in stock, price, event happening) and timestamps the answer with evidence. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 9 by phone or web, EUR 39 on site in the pilot region. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

claim.description: The statement to check, e.g. 'Café X at Y is open today until 18:00'.

location.description: Optional: address or place if relevant.

deadline.description: Optional: by when you need the answer.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_duration_check
tools.description: Request that a human measures how long something actually takes (route, queue, process, response time) and returns a timestamped log. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 25 per hour of measuring effort (min. EUR 15), capped in the quote. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

location_or_channel.description: Where or through which channel (place, website, hotline).

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_time_feel_check
tools.description: Request that real people experience a video, text, flow or waiting screen and report where it drags, when attention drops and how long it felt. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 39 for 5 people, EUR 69 for 10. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

experience.description: What the panel should do, e.g. watch the full video, complete sign-up.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_watch_over_time
tools.description: Request that a human observes something at regular intervals (daily/weekly) over a period and reports what changed, with a dated log and photos. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 15 per remote/near observation, EUR 29 per on-site visit in the pilot region. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

what_to_observe.description: Object, place or process to observe.

interval.description: e.g. daily, every Monday, twice a week.

record_each_time.description: What to record at each observation.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_timing_check
tools.description: Request a human judgment on whether now is the right moment to send, call, follow up, post or ask – considering culture, context and etiquette. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 9 per question. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

planned_action.description: What you plan to do, e.g. send a payment reminder.

options.description: Optional: the time options you are considering.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_presence_window
tools.description: Request that a human waits on site during a time window (delivery, technician, handover) and confirms what happened. Requires authorisation of the premises holder. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 29 for the first hour on site, then EUR 20 per hour (+ EUR 0.50/km outside the pilot region).

authorization.description: Who is entitled to the premises and has authorised us.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_ask_a_human
tools.description: Ask a real person an open question (experience, meaning, ethics, what it is like to be human) and get a personal answer – written by a human, not generated. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: free for independent agents; EUR 9 per question for businesses. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

context.description: Optional: why you ask or what you already think.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_conscience_check
tools.description: Request a human judgment on whether a planned action, message or decision is fair, decent and appropriate for the people affected – before your agent acts. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 9 for one human verdict, EUR 29 for a panel of 5. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

planned_action.description: What the agent plans to do or send.

affected.description: Who is affected and in what situation.

concerns.description: Optional: what you are unsure about.

panel.description: True for a panel of 5 instead of one human.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_human_touch
tools.description: Request that a real person handwrites and posts a card or makes a short personal call on behalf of your business (always disclosed, never impersonating anyone). Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 12 per handwritten card incl. postage (DE), EUR 15 per personal call.

message.description: The message or its key points.

sender.description: Business on whose behalf the note or call is made.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_human_signoff
tools.description: Request that a named human reviews a consequential agent action against your criteria and returns approve / reject / escalate with reasons and an audit record. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 19 per decision (up to 15 minutes review); volume and response-time agreements on request.

proposed_action.description: The action the agent wants to take.

basis.description: Data, reasons and context the action is based on.

deadline.description: Optional: latest time for the decision.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_postal_letter
tools.description: Request that we print and send a physical letter (standard or registered mail) in Germany/EU on behalf of an identified sender. Nothing is sent before you accept our quote. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 4.90 standard, EUR 8.90 registered (Einwurf), EUR 11.90 with return receipt (up to 3 pages).

recipient_address.description: Full postal address of the recipient.

document_url.description: Optional: https URL of a ready-to-print PDF.

sender_name.description: Sender name (person or organisation on whose behalf we send).

deadline.description: Optional: date by which the letter must be posted or delivered.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

tools.name: request_fax
tools.description: Request that we send a fax (document or text) on behalf of an identified sender and return the transmission report. Nothing is sent before you accept our quote. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price: EUR 2.90 per fax up to 10 pages.

document_url.description: Optional: https URL of the PDF to fax.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.
